articles.title_cn: 最小化遗憾的项目选择
articles.abstract_en: An agent observes the set of available projects and proposes some, but not necessarily all, of them. A principal chooses one or none from the proposed set. We solve for a mechanism that minimizes the principal's worst‐case regret. We compare the single‐project environment in which the agent can propose only one project with the multiproject environment in which he can propose many. In both environments, if the agent proposes one project, it is chosen for sure if the principal's payoff is sufficiently high; otherwise, the probability that it is chosen decreases in the agent's payoff. In the multiproject environment, the agent's payoff from proposing multiple projects equals his maximal payoff from proposing each project alone. The multiproject environment outperforms the single‐project one by providing better fallback options than rejection and by delivering this payoff to the agent more efficiently.
articles.abstract_cn: 一个代理人观察可用的项目集合，并提出其中一些，但不一定是全部。委托人从提议的集合中选择一个或一个都不选。我们求解了一个最小化委托人最坏情况遗憾的机制。我们比较了代理人只能提议一个项目的单项目环境和他可以提议多个项目的多项目环境。在两种环境中，如果代理人提议一个项目，当委托人的收益足够高时，该项目肯定会被选中；否则，该项目被选中的概率随代理人的收益增加而降低。在多项目环境中，代理人提议多个项目的收益等于他单独提议每个项目所获得的最大收益。多项目环境通过提供比拒绝更好的后备选项，并更有效地向代理人传递这一收益，从而优于单项目环境。

articles.title_en: Selection Into Credit Markets: Evidence From Agriculture in Mali
articles.title_cn: 信贷市场的选择：来自马里农业的证据
articles.abstract_en: We use a two‐stage experiment on agricultural lending in Mali to test whether selection into lending is predictive of heterogeneous returns to capital. Understanding this heterogeneity, and the selection process which reveals it, is critical for guiding modeling of credit markets in developing countries, as well as for policy. We find such heterogeneity: returns to capital are higher for farmers who borrow than for those who do not. In our first stage, we offer loans in some villages and not others. In the second stage, we provide cash grants to a random subset of all farmers in villages where no loans were offered, and to a random subset of the farmers who do not borrow in villages where loans were offered. We estimate seasonal returns to the grant of 130% for would‐be borrowers, whereas we find returns near zero for the sample representative of non‐borrowers. We also provide evidence that there are some farmers—particularly those that are poor at baseline—that have high returns but do not receive a loan.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们利用马里农业贷款的两阶段实验来检验贷款选择是否能预测资本回报的异质性。理解这种异质性以及揭示它的选择过程，对于指导发展中国家信贷市场的建模以及政策制定至关重要。我们发现存在这种异质性：借款农民的资本回报高于不借款的农民。在第一阶段，我们在一些村庄提供贷款，而在其他村庄不提供。在第二阶段，我们向未提供贷款村庄的所有农民中的随机子集提供现金赠款，并向提供贷款村庄中不借款的农民中的随机子集提供现金赠款。我们估计潜在借款人的赠款季节性回报为130%，而对于非借款人代表性样本，我们发现回报接近于零。我们还提供证据表明，有些农民——特别是那些基线时贫困的农民——具有高回报但未获得贷款。

articles.title_en: Infinite Debt Rollover in Stochastic Economies
articles.title_cn: 随机经济中的无限债务滚动
articles.abstract_en: This paper shows that there is more scope for a borrower to engage in a sustainable infinite debt rollover (a “Ponzi scheme”) when interest/growth rates are stochastic. In this context, I prove that the relevant “r vs. g” comparison uses the yield r long to an infinite‐maturity zero‐coupon bond. I show that r long is lower than the risk‐neutral expectation of the short‐term yield when it is variable, and that r long is close to the minimal realization of the short‐term yield when it is highly persistent. The paper applies these results to illustrative heterogeneous agent dynamic stochastic general equilibrium models to obtain similarly weakened sufficient conditions for the existence of public debt bubbles.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文表明，当利率/增长率是随机的时，借款人进行可持续的无限债务滚动（“庞氏骗局”）的空间更大。在此背景下，我证明了相关的“r与g”比较使用的是长期零息债券的收益率r long。我表明，当短期收益率可变时，r long低于其风险中性预期，并且当短期收益率高度持久时，r long接近其最小实现值。本文将这些结果应用于说明性的异质主体动态随机一般均衡模型，以获得类似的放宽的公共债务泡沫存在的充分条件。

articles.title_en: The Investment Effects of Market Integration: Evidence From Renewable Energy Expansion in Chile
articles.title_cn: 市场一体化的投资效应：来自智利可再生能源扩张的证据
articles.abstract_en: We study the investment effects of market integration on renewable energy expansion. Our theory highlights that market integration not only improves allocative efficiency by gains from trade but also incentivizes new investment in renewable power plants. To test our theoretical predictions, we examine how recent grid expansions in the Chilean electricity market changed electricity production, wholesale prices, generation costs, and renewable investments. We then build a structural model of power plant entry to quantify the impact of market integration with and without the investment effects. We find that the market integration in Chile increased solar generation by around 180%, saved generation costs by 8%, and reduced carbon emissions by 5%. A substantial amount of renewable entry would not have occurred in the absence of market integration. Our findings suggest that ignoring these investment effects would substantially understate the benefits of market integration and its important role in expanding renewable energy.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们研究了市场一体化对可再生能源扩张的投资效应。我们的理论强调，市场一体化不仅通过贸易收益提高配置效率，还激励对可再生能源发电厂的新投资。为检验我们的理论预测，我们考察了智利电力市场近期的电网扩张如何改变电力生产、批发价格、发电成本和可再生能源投资。然后，我们构建了一个发电厂进入的结构模型，以量化在有和没有投资效应的情况下市场一体化的影响。我们发现，智利的市场一体化使太阳能发电量增加了约180%，节省了8%的发电成本，并减少了5%的碳排放。如果没有市场一体化，大量可再生能源的进入将不会发生。我们的研究结果表明，忽视这些投资效应将大大低估市场一体化的收益及其在扩大可再生能源方面的重要作用。

articles.title_en: What Can Time‐Series Regressions Tell Us About Policy Counterfactuals?
articles.title_cn: 时间序列回归能告诉我们关于政策反事实的什么？
articles.abstract_en: We show that, in a general family of linearized structural macroeconomic models, knowledge of the empirically estimable causal effects of contemporaneous and news shocks to the prevailing policy rule is sufficient to construct counterfactuals under alternative policy rules. If the researcher is willing to postulate a loss function, our results furthermore allow her to recover an optimal policy rule for that loss. Under our assumptions, the derived counterfactuals and optimal policies are robust to the Lucas critique. We then discuss strategies for applying these insights when only a limited amount of empirical causal evidence on policy shock transmission is available.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们表明，在一族一般的线性化结构宏观经济模型中，对现行政策规则下的同期冲击和新闻冲击的可经验估计的因果效应的了解，足以构建替代政策规则下的反事实。如果研究者愿意设定一个损失函数，我们的结果还允许她恢复该损失的最优政策规则。在我们的假设下，推导出的反事实和最优政策对卢卡斯批判是稳健的。然后，我们讨论了当仅有有限的经验因果证据关于政策冲击传导时应用这些见解的策略。

articles.title_en: Monitoring versus Discounting in Repeated Games
articles.title_cn: 重复博弈中的监督与贴现
articles.abstract_en: We study how discounting and monitoring jointly determine whether cooperation is possible in repeated games with imperfect (public or private) monitoring. Our main result provides a simple bound on the strength of players' incentives as a function of discounting, monitoring precision, and on‐path payoff variance. We show that the bound is tight in the low‐discounting/low‐monitoring double limit, by establishing a public‐monitoring folk theorem where the discount factor and the monitoring structure can vary simultaneously.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们研究在具有不完美（公开或私人）监督的重复博弈中，贴现和监督如何共同决定合作是否可能。我们的主要结果提供了一个关于玩家激励强度的简单界限，该界限是贴现、监督精度和路径上收益方差的函数。我们通过建立一个公开监督的民间定理，其中贴现因子和监督结构可以同时变化，证明了该界限在低贴现/低监督的双重极限下是紧的。

articles.title_en: Mitigating Disaster Risks in the Age of Climate Change
articles.title_cn: 气候变化时代减轻灾害风险
articles.abstract_en: Emissions abatement alone cannot address the consequences of global warming for weather disasters. We model how society adapts to manage disaster risks to capital stock. Optimal adaptation—a mix of firm‐level efforts and public spending—varies as society learns about the adverse consequences of global warming for disaster arrivals. Taxes on capital are needed alongside those on carbon to achieve the first best. We apply our model to country‐level control of flooding from tropical cyclones. Learning rationalizes empirical findings, including the responses of Tobin's q , equity risk premium, and risk‐free rate to disaster arrivals. Adaptation is more valuable under learning than a counterfactual no‐learning environment. Learning alters social‐cost‐of‐carbon projections due to the interaction of uncertainty resolution and endogenous adaptive response.
articles.abstract_cn: 仅靠减排无法解决全球变暖对天气灾害的影响。我们模拟了社会如何适应管理资本存量的灾害风险。最优适应——企业层面努力与公共支出的组合——随着社会了解全球变暖对灾害发生的负面影响而变化。除了碳税，还需要对资本征税以实现最优。我们将模型应用于国家层面热带气旋洪水的控制。学习使实证发现合理化，包括托宾q、股权风险溢价和无风险利率对灾害发生的反应。在学习环境下，适应比反事实的无学习环境更有价值。由于不确定性解决与内生适应性反应的相互作用，学习改变了社会碳成本预测。

articles.title_en: Platform Design When Sellers Use Pricing Algorithms
articles.title_cn: 当卖家使用定价算法时的平台设计
articles.abstract_en: We investigate the ability of a platform to design its marketplace to promote competition, improve consumer surplus, and increase its own payoff. We consider demand‐steering rules that reward firms that cut prices with additional exposure to consumers. We examine the impact of these rules both in theory and by using simulations with artificial intelligence pricing algorithms (specifically Q‐learning algorithms, which are commonly used in computer science). Our theoretical results indicate that these policies (which require little information to implement) can have strongly beneficial effects, even when sellers are infinitely patient and seek to collude. Similarly, our simulations suggest that platform design can benefit consumers and the platform, but that achieving these gains may require policies that condition on past behavior and treat sellers in a nonneutral fashion. These more sophisticated policies disrupt the ability of algorithms to rotate demand and split industry profits, leading to low prices.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们研究了平台设计其市场以促进竞争、改善消费者剩余并增加自身收益的能力。我们考虑了需求引导规则，这些规则奖励降价企业以额外的消费者曝光。我们在理论上和使用人工智能定价算法（特别是计算机科学中常用的Q学习算法）的模拟中检验了这些规则的影响。我们的理论结果表明，这些政策（实施所需信息很少）可以产生强烈的有益效果，即使卖家无限耐心并试图合谋。同样，我们的模拟表明，平台设计可以使消费者和平台受益，但实现这些收益可能需要基于过去行为并以非中立方式对待卖家的政策。这些更复杂的政策破坏了算法轮换需求和分配行业利润的能力，导致低价格。

articles.abstract_en: R&D investment reduces current profits, so short‐term pressure to hit profit targets may distort R&D. In the data, firms just meeting Wall Street forecasts have lower R&D growth and subsequent innovation, while managers just missing receive lower pay. But short‐termist distortions might not quantitatively matter if aggregation or equilibrium dampen their impact. So I build and estimate a quantitative endogenous growth model in which short‐termism arises naturally as discipline on conflicted managers and boosts firm value by about 1%. But short‐termism reduces R&D, and the social return to R&D is higher than the private return due to standard channels including knowledge spillovers and imperfect competition. So at the macro level, short‐termist distortions slow growth by 5 basis points yearly and lower social welfare by about 1%.
articles.abstract_cn: 研发投资会减少当前利润，因此实现利润目标的短期压力可能会扭曲研发。在数据中，刚好达到华尔街预测的公司研发增长和后续创新较低，而刚好未达标的经理人薪酬较低。但短期主义扭曲可能不会在数量上产生重要影响，如果加总或均衡削弱了它们的影响。因此，我构建并估计了一个定量内生增长模型，其中短期主义自然产生于对冲突经理人的约束，并使企业价值提高约1%。但短期主义减少了研发，而研发的社会回报高于私人回报，原因包括知识溢出和不完全竞争等标准渠道。因此，在宏观层面，短期主义扭曲使年增长率降低5个基点，并使社会福利降低约1%。
